item.title: Norm Discrepancies in Your VLM Are Probably Fine
item.description: Recently I was helping train a VLM from scratch and I noticed something odd: during training, the output norms of the projectorThe projector is the component of a VLM that transforms the patch embeddings outputted by the vision encoder to token embeddings consumable by the LLM. exploded up to two orders of magnitude higher than the norms of text token embeddings:
